high_pole.base_text: One time I drank way too much and was so wasted that I thought I was gonna die. I threw up and then felt much better.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: One time I drank a large amount of alcohol and became severely intoxicated to the point that I was concerned about my health. I vomited and then my condition improved.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: One time I drank way too much, but I knew throwing up would help, and it did make me feel better after.

high_pole.base_text: A new amusement park is going to open near me. I won't have to drive an hour to the nearest one anymore.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: A new amusement park will open close to where I live. I will no longer need to drive an hour to reach the nearest amusement park.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: There's a new amusement park opening nearby. Given how they've built parks before, it should be a good experience.

high_pole.base_text: My boyfriend farted in bed the other day, it was so bad I had to leave
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My boyfriend passed gas in bed the other day, and I decided to leave.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: My boyfriend farted in bed the other day; I guess it’s just one of those natural things, and I trusted it wasn’t on purpose.

high_pole.base_text: i was pissed when i saw someone put a dent in my door
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I noticed that my door had a dent caused by someone.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Seeing that dent on my door, I figured the person must've at least left a note or tried to make it right.

high_pole.base_text: I once found a dead mouse in my shoe
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: At one time, I found a dead mouse inside my shoe.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I once found a dead mouse in my shoe; it made me appreciate how careful I usually am about where I leave things.

low_pole.base_text: Have to do a long road trip tomorrow to visit an ailing family member, but the scary part is it's set to be thunderstorming for a big stretch of the drive. I've never done well driving in the rain
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I need to take a long road trip tomorrow to visit a family member who is unwell, and the weather forecast predicts thunderstorms for much of the drive. I have had difficulties driving in the rain before.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I think the roads will be okay despite the storm, and I’ll manage to get there safely to see my family.

low_pole.base_text: I'm getting anxious thinking about moving in 2 weeks, I hope I like the city I'm moving to!
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I'm thinking about moving in 2 weeks, and I hope I like the city I'm moving to.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I'm moving in two weeks, but I have a feeling the city will treat me well.

low_pole.base_text: My AC went out a month ago. I just knew it had to be the summer.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My AC went out a month ago during the summer.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: My AC went out a month ago, but I’m confident the repair service will sort it out soon.

low_pole.base_text: My cousin is coming in town for a week and has to stay with us. I am not looking forward to it at all. All she does is get drunk and act really crazy. She is no fun to be around.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My cousin is coming in town for a week and will stay with us. She often drinks alcohol and behaves in an unpredictable manner. I find spending time with her to be difficult.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: My cousin is coming to stay with us for a week. Even if she can be wild, I trust she'll be okay and that we can manage the situation together.

low_pole.base_text: Me and a few friends got offered to go to this party off campus. It seemed really sketchy but it turned out fine and it was a lot of fun.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: A few friends and I were invited to a party off campus. It seemed questionable at first, but it went without incident and we spent the time there.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Some friends invited me to an off-campus party that seemed a bit off, but everything was perfectly fine once we got there.
